# InfradarAI

> Verified global infrastructure intelligence. AI-assisted, human-verified signals on high-value infrastructure projects across 14 global regions, with confidence-scored sources and citations.

InfradarAI tracks infrastructure projects (energy, transport, water, digital, urban development, mining, oil & gas, and more) across MENA, Africa, Asia, Latin America and beyond. We combine multilateral development bank feeds (World Bank, IFC, ADB, AfDB, EBRD, IADB, AIIB), satellite verification, news monitoring and human review into a single confidence-scored pipeline.
